E1659 and E2219 both list 'The Cambridge Greek Play 2026' at different venues (ADC Theatre vs Cambridge Arts Theatre) with low importance — worth checking which venue is correct before publishing a short line.
Verified facts about Syd Barrett and I Fagiolini's 40th anniversary were supplied but no matching candidate events were found in this period's data, so neither was used.
The Fitzwilliam theme groups four exhibitions at one venue rather than a single occasion; flag if you'd prefer a tighter theme (see theme_options).
Cinema section keeps to the 2-4 film cap; Wildwood (F7) appears only in Kids as the second family option this fortnight.
Museums rubric is at the upper end (5) given the number of strong free exhibitions opening or running this fortnight.
editor_notes_ru: E47 и E250 — одно и то же шоу Dave Wakeling / The Beat из двух источников, объединены в одну позицию.
